root.label: C++26 core additions
root.note: Four C++26 pillars modernize safety, compile-time introspection, async concurrency, and uninitialized locals.

children.label: Contracts (P2900)
children.note: Language-level pre, post, and contract_assert assertions with configurable runtime semantics.

children.label: Four evaluation semantics
children.note: Toolchains choose ignore, observe, enforce, or quick_enforce outside source code.

children.label: Enforce vs quick_enforce
children.note: Both terminate on failure, with quick_enforce skipping the violation handler.

children.label: Constification rules
children.note: Predicates view variables as const; postconditions require const value parameters.

children.label: Violation handler
children.note: contract_violation reports kind, semantic, mode, location, and terminating status.

children.label: Static reflection (P2996)
children.note: Value-based compile-time introspection via ^^ and consteval std::meta::info.

children.label: Reflection operator ^^
children.note: Produces a consteval std::meta::info value for types, members, functions, or templates.

children.label: Splicing and template for
children.note: Splices [:r:] reify reflections while template for unrolls reflection ranges.

children.label: std::define_static_array
children.note: Converts compile-time reflection vectors into static arrays usable by template for.

children.label: Access context
children.note: access_context::current() enforces member visibility unless unchecked() is requested.

children.label: std::execution (P2300)
children.note: Zero-allocation structured async pipelines built from senders, receivers, and schedulers.

children.label: Three completion channels
children.note: Every sender finishes with set_value, set_error, or cooperative set_stopped.

children.label: Structured cancellation
children.note: set_stopped propagates cancellation signals downstream without throwing exceptions.

children.label: Connect and start
children.note: Sender pipelines stay inert until connected into an operation state and started.

children.label: std::this_thread::sync_wait
children.note: Blocks the caller at the pipeline boundary until the sender completes.

children.label: Erroneous behavior (P2795)
children.note: Eliminates time-travel UB from uninitialized automatic scalars while preserving opt-out.

children.label: Deterministic erroneous value
children.note: Reading an uninitialized local triggers well-defined erroneous behavior, not unbounded UB.

children.label: [[indeterminate]] opt-out
children.note: Explicitly marks hot-path scratch buffers to retain uninitialized storage semantics.
